Aasimar.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium or Small | Speed: 30 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Celestial Resistance: Resistance to Necrotic and Radiant damage.
• Healing Hands: As an Action, touch a creature to restore d4s equal to your PB. (1/Long Rest).
• Light Bearer: You know the Light cantrip.
• Celestial Revelation (Lvl 3): Transform for 1 min (Heavenly Wings, Radiant Soul, or Necrotic Shroud).

Changeling.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium or Small | Speed: 30 ft.
• Shapechanger: You can use an action to change your appearance and your voice. You determine the specifics of the changes.
• Changeling Instincts: You gain proficiency with two skills of your choice from Deception, Intimidation, Insight, and Performance.

Chromatic Dragonborn.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 30 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Draconic Ancestry: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.
• Breath Weapon: Replace 1 attack with 15ft cone or 30ft line. DEX save (DC 8 + CON mod + PB). Deals 1d10 damage. Usage: PB times per Long Rest.
• Damage Resistance: Resistance to chosen element.

Metallic Dragonborn.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 30 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Draconic Ancestry: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.
• Breath Weapon: 15ft cone dealing 1d10 damage (DEX save). PB times per Long Rest.
• Damage Resistance: Resistance to chosen element.

Gem Dragonborn.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 30 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Draconic Ancestry: Choose Force, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder.
• Breath Weapon: 15ft cone dealing 1d10 damage (DEX save). PB times per Long Rest.
• Psionic Sending: Telepathy up to 30ft.

Dwarf.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 30 ft.
• Dwarven Toughness: HP max increases by 1 at Lvl 1 and +1 per additional Level.
• Darkvision: 120 feet.
• Poison Resilience: Advantage on saves vs poison, and Poison Resistance.
• Stonecunning: Bonus Action Tremorsense 60ft on stone for 10 min. Usage: PB times per Long Rest.

High Elf.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 30 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Fey Ancestry: Advantage vs Charm; immune to magical sleep.
• Keen Senses: Proficiency in Perception.
• Elven Lineage (High Elf): You learn 1 Wizard Cantrip (e.g. Prestidigitation). Lvl 3: Detect Magic. Lvl 5: Misty Step.

Wood Elf.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 35 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Fey Ancestry & Keen Senses: Adv. vs Charm, Sleep Immunity, Perception proficiency.
• Elven Lineage (Wood Elf): You learn Druidcraft. Lvl 3: Longstrider. Lvl 5: Pass Without Trace.

Drow.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 30 ft.
• Superior Darkvision: 120 feet.
• Fey Ancestry & Keen Senses: Adv. vs Charm, Sleep Immunity, Perception proficiency.
• Elven Lineage (Drow): You learn Dancing Lights. Lvl 3: Faerie Fire. Lvl 5: Darkness.

Rock Gnome.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Small | Speed: 30 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Gnome Cunning: Advantage on INT, WIS, and CHA saves against magic.
• Gnomish Lineage (Rock Gnome): You learn Prestidigitation and can create tiny clockwork devices.

Forest Gnome.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Small | Speed: 30 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Gnome Cunning: Advantage on INT, WIS, and CHA saves against magic.
• Gnomish Lineage (Forest Gnome): You learn Minor Illusion and can cast Speak with Animals (PB times per Long Rest).

Cloud Giant Lineage.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 35 ft.
• Cloud Jaunt: Bonus Action teleport up to 30ft. Usage: PB times per Long Rest.
• Powerful Build: Increased carrying capacity.

Fire Giant Lineage.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 35 ft.
• Fire's Burn: Deal +1d10 Fire damage on hit. Usage: PB times per Long Rest.
• Powerful Build: Increased carrying capacity.

Frost Giant Lineage.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 35 ft.
• Frost's Chill: Deal +1d6 Cold damage on hit & -10ft speed. Usage: PB times per Long Rest.
• Powerful Build: Increased carrying capacity.

Hill Giant Lineage.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 35 ft.
• Hill's Tumble: Knock target Prone on hit. Usage: PB times per Long Rest.
• Powerful Build: Increased carrying capacity.

Stone Giant Lineage.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 35 ft.
• Stone's Endurance: Reaction to reduce damage by 1d12 + CON mod. Usage: PB times per Long Rest.
• Powerful Build: Increased carrying capacity.

Storm Giant Lineage.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 35 ft.
• Storm's Thunder: Reaction when damaged: deal 1d8 Thunder damage. Usage: PB times per Long Rest.
• Powerful Build: Increased carrying capacity.

Halfling.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Small | Speed: 30 ft.
• Lucky: Reroll natural 1s on d20 rolls.
• Brave: Advantage on saves vs Frightened.
• Halfling Nimbleness: Move through space of larger creatures.
• Naturally Stealthy: Hide behind Medium or larger creatures.

Human.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium or Small | Speed: 30 ft.
• Resourceful: Gain Heroic Inspiration after every Long Rest.
• Skillful: Gain proficiency in 1 skill of choice.
• Versatile: Gain 1 Origin Feat of choice.

Kalashtar.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 30 ft.
• Dual Mind: You have advantage on Wisdom saving throws.
• Mental Discipline: You have resistance to Psychic damage.
• Mind Link: You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 10 feet of you.

Orc.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 30 ft.
• Darkvision: 120 feet.
• Adrenaline Rush: Bonus Action Dash + Temp HP equal to PB. Usage: PB times per Long Rest.
• Relentless Endurance: Drop to 1 HP instead of 0 HP once per Long Rest.

Beasthide.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 30 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Shifting: Bonus action to transform, gaining temporary hit points and a bonus to Armor Class.

Longtooth.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 30 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Shifting: Bonus action to transform, enabling a ferocious bite attack.

Swiftstride.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 35 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Shifting: Bonus action to transform, increasing speed and allowing reaction movement.

Wildhunt.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 30 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Shifting: Bonus action to transform, preventing enemies from gaining advantage against you.

Abyssal Tiefling.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium or Small | Speed: 30 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Fiendish Legacy (Abyssal): Poison Resistance. You learn Poison Spray. Lvl 3: Ray of Sickness. Lvl 5: Hold Person.

Chthonic Tiefling.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium or Small | Speed: 30 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Fiendish Legacy (Chthonic): Necrotic Resistance. You learn Chill Touch. Lvl 3: False Life. Lvl 5: Ray of Enfeeblement.

Fiendish Tiefling.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium or Small | Speed: 30 ft.
• Darkvision: 60 feet.
• Fiendish Legacy (Fiendish): Fire Resistance. You learn Fire Bolt. Lvl 3: Hellish Rebuke. Lvl 5: Darkness.

Warforged.text:
Creature Type: Humanoid | Size: Medium | Speed: 30 ft.
• Constructed Resilience: Advantage on saves vs poison, resistance to poison damage, immune to disease, don't need to eat, drink, or breathe, and magic can't put you to sleep.
• Sentry's Rest: You don't need to sleep and remain conscious during long rests.
• Integrated Protection: +1 to Armor Class.

Artificer.text:
Level 1 Features:
• Magical Tinkering: Infuse tiny nonmagical objects with minor magical properties.
• Spellcasting: Prepare INT mod + 1 Level 1 spells daily. Focus: Thieves' Tools or Tinker's Tools.

equipment.fixed: Studded Leather Armor, Dagger, Quarterstaff, Thieves' Tools, Tinker's Tools, Dungeoneer's Pack, 16 GP

Barbarian.text:
Level 1 Features:
• Rage: Bonus Action to enter Rage (2/Long Rest). +2 damage, Adv. on STR checks/saves, physical damage Resistance.
• Unarmored Defense: AC = 10 + DEX mod + CON mod.
• Weapon Mastery: Master 2 weapon properties.

Bard.text:
Level 1 Features:
• Bardic Inspiration: Grant a d6 die to a creature within 60ft.
• Spellcasting: Know 2 Cantrips, prepare 4 Level 1 spells daily.

equipment.fixed: Leather Armor, Musical Instrument, Entertainer's Pack, 18 GP

Cleric.text:
Level 1 Features:
• Divine Order: Choose Protector (Heavy Armor & Martial Weapons) OR Thaumaturg (Extra Cantrip + Religion bonus).
• Spellcasting: Know 3 Cantrips, prepare WIS mod + 1 Level 1 spells daily.

equipment.fixed: Chain Mail or Scale Mail, Mace, Light Crossbow, Shield, Holy Symbol, Priest's Pack, 7 GP

Druid.text:
Level 1 Features:
• Primal Order: Choose Magician (Extra Cantrip + Nature bonus) OR Warden (Medium Armor & Martial Weapons).
• Wild Companion: Cast Find Familiar.
• Spellcasting: Know 2 Cantrips, prepare WIS mod + 1 Level 1 spells.

equipment.fixed: Leather Armor, Quarterstaff, Shield, Druidic Focus, Explorer's Pack, 9 GP

Fighter.text:
Level 1 Features:
• Fighting Style: Gain 1 Fighting Style feat.
• Second Wind: Bonus Action to regain 1d10 + Lvl HP.
• Weapon Mastery: Master 3 weapon properties.

Monk.text:
Level 1 Features:
• Unarmored Defense: AC = 10 + DEX mod + WIS mod.
• Martial Arts: Unarmed die = 1d6. Use DEX for unarmed/Monk weapons.

equipment.fixed: 10 Daggers, Artisan's Tools, Explorer's Pack, 11 GP

Paladin.text:
Level 1 Features:
• Lay on Hands: Pool of 5 HP healing.
• Spellcasting: Prepare CHA mod + 1 Level 1 spells daily (includes free Divine Smite).
• Weapon Mastery: Master 2 weapon properties.

equipment.fixed: Chain Mail, Shield, Holy Symbol, Priest's Pack, 9 GP

Ranger.text:
Level 1 Features:
• Favored Enemy: Free prepared Hunter's Mark.
• Spellcasting: Prepare 2 Level 1 spells daily.
• Weapon Mastery: Master 2 weapon properties.

equipment.fixed: Studded Leather Armor, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Explorer's Pack, 7 GP

Rogue.text:
Level 1 Features:
• Sneak Attack: +1d6 extra damage on hit with Finesse/Ranged weapon.
• Expertise: Double PB for 2 skills/tools.
• Weapon Mastery: Master 2 weapon properties.

equipment.fixed: Leather Armor, Thieves' Tools, Burglar's Pack, 18 GP

Sorcerer.text:
Level 1 Features:
• Innate Sorcery: Bonus Action: Adv. on Sorcerer spell attack rolls & +1 Spell Save DC.
• Spellcasting: Know 4 Cantrips, prepare 2 Level 1 spells.

equipment.fixed: Quarterstaff, Dagger, Arcane Focus, Dungeoneer's Pack, 28 GP

Warlock.text:
Level 1 Features:
• Eldritch Invocations: Gain 1 Invocation at Lvl 1.
• Pact Magic: Know 2 Cantrips, prepare 2 Level 1 spells.

equipment.fixed: Leather Armor, Dagger, Arcane Focus, Scholar's Pack, 15 GP

Wizard.text:
Level 1 Features:
• Arcane Recovery: Regain 1 Level 1 spell slot after Short Rest once/day.
• Ritual Casting: Cast Ritual spells directly from Spellbook.
• Spellcasting: Prepare INT mod + 1 Level 1 spells daily.

equipment.fixed: Quarterstaff, Spellbook, Arcane Focus, Scholar's Pack, 10 GP

Acolyte.text: Origin Feat: Magic Initiate (Cleric) — Gain 2 Cleric Cantrips and 1 Level 1 Cleric spell.

Artisan.text: Origin Feat: Crafter — Gain tool proficiencies and a 20% discount on nonmagical items.

Charlatan.text: Origin Feat: Skilled — Gain proficiency in 3 skills or tools of choice.

Criminal.text: Origin Feat: Alert — Gain +PB to Initiative and swap Initiative with willing allies.

Entertainer.text: Origin Feat: Musician — Grant Heroic Inspiration to allies after a Rest.

Farmer.text: Origin Feat: Tough — Increase HP maximum by +2 per character level.

Guard.text: Origin Feat: Alert — Gain +PB to Initiative and swap Initiative with allies.

Guide.text: Origin Feat: Magic Initiate (Druid) — Gain 2 Druid Cantrips and 1 Level 1 Druid spell.

Hermit.text: Origin Feat: Healer — Reroll 1s on healing dice and use Healer's Kit.

Merchant.text: Origin Feat: Lucky — Gain Luck Points equal to PB.

Noble.text: Origin Feat: Skilled — Gain proficiency in 3 skills or tools.

Sage.text: Origin Feat: Magic Initiate (Wizard) — Gain 2 Wizard Cantrips and 1 Level 1 Wizard spell.

Sailor.text: Origin Feat: Tavern Brawler — Reroll 1s on Unarmed damage, push foes 5ft with Unarmed strike.

Soldier.text: Origin Feat: Savage Attacker — Roll weapon damage dice twice once per turn.

Wayfarer.text: Origin Feat: Lucky — Gain Luck Points equal to PB for rerolls.

skills.Acrobatics: Akrobatik (Geschicklichkeit): Hilft dir, die Balance zu halten, über schmale Vorsprünge zu laufen oder Saltos zu schlagen.
skills.Animal Handling: Tierumgang (Weisheit): Ermöglicht es dir, Tiere zu beruhigen, ihre Reaktionen einzuschätzen oder Reittiere zu lenken.
skills.Arcana: Arkankunde (Intelligenz): Dein Wissen über Zauber, magische Gegenstände, arkane Symbole und Bestien magischen Ursprungs.
skills.Athletics: Athletik (Stärke): Deckt körperliche Kraftakte wie Klettern, Springen, Schwimmen oder das Durchbrechen von Hindernissen ab.
skills.Crafting: Handwerk (Intelligenz): Erlaubt dir das Reparieren von Gegenständen, den Umgang mit Werkzeugen oder das Herstellen von Ausrüstung.
skills.Deception: Täuschen (Charisma): Hilft dir, andere durch Worte, Lügen oder raffinierte Verkleidungen in die Irre zu führen.
skills.History: Geschichte (Intelligenz): Dein Wissen über vergangene Ereignisse, königliche Familien, Kriege, Legenden und alte Zivilisationen.
skills.Insight: Einblick (Weisheit): Die Fähigkeit, die Absichten, Emotionen oder Täuschungen einer anderen Person anhand ihrer Körpersprache zu erkennen.
skills.Intimidation: Einschüchtern (Charisma): Anderen durch Drohungen, Stärke oder finstere Blicke Angst einjagen, um ihren Willen zu brechen.
skills.Investigation: Untersuchung (Intelligenz): Gezieltes Suchen nach Hinweisen, das Kombinieren von Spuren oder das Entschlüsseln von Logikrätseln.
skills.Medicine: Heilkunde (Weisheit): Ermöglicht das Stabilisieren sterbender Gefährten oder das Diagnostizieren von Krankheiten und Verletzungen.
skills.Nature: Naturkunde (Intelligenz): Dein Wissen über Pflanzen, Tiere, Wetterbedingungen und geografische Gegebenheiten der Wildnis.
skills.Perception: Wahrnehmung (Weisheit): Passive oder aktive Sinne (Hören, Sehen, Riechen), um versteckte Dinge oder lauernde Gefahren zu entdecken.
skills.Performance: Bühnenkunst (Charisma): Talent für Musik, Schauspiel, Tanz, Geschichtenerzählen oder das Unterhalten von Publikum.
skills.Persuasion: Überzeugen (Charisma): Andere durch Diplomatie, Höflichkeit, gute Argumente oder Charme auf deine Seite zu ziehen.
skills.Religion: Religion (Intelligenz): Wissen über Gottheiten, heilige Riten, Sekten, Gebete und göttliche Symbole.
skills.Sleight of Hand: Fingerfertigkeit (Geschicklichkeit): Nützlich für Taschendiebstahl, Zaubertricks oder das Verstecken kleiner Gegenstände.
skills.Stealth: Heimlichkeit (Geschicklichkeit): Das unbemerkte Bewegen im Schatten, Schleichen und Verstecken vor Gegnern.
skills.Survival: Überleben (Weisheit): Spurenlesen, das Finden von Nahrung in der Wildnis, Orientierung und das Vermeiden von Naturgefahren.

Acid Splash.rule:
School: Evocation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 60 ft | Components: V, S
• Bubble of acid: 1-2 targets DEX save or 1d6 Acid damage.

Blade Ward.rule:
School: Abjuration (Concentration) | Casting Time: 1 Reaction | Range: Self | Components: V, S
• Subtract 1d4 from enemy attack roll.

Chill Touch.rule:
School: Necromancy | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: Touch | Components: V, S
• Melee spell attack: 1d10 Necrotic damage & target can't heal until start of your next turn.

Dancing Lights.rule:
School: Illusion (Concentration) | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 120 ft | Components: V, S, M
• Create 4 torch-sized lights.

Druidcraft.rule:
School: Transmutation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 30 ft | Components: V, S
• Minor nature effects: weather, bloom, candle light/snuff.

Eldritch Blast.rule:
School: Evocation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 120 ft | Components: V, S
• Ranged attack: 1d10 Force damage.

Elementalism.rule:
School: Transmutation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 30 ft | Components: V, S
• Minor elemental effects: Breeze, Fire Spark, Sculpt Dust, Water Spray.

Fire Bolt.rule:
School: Evocation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 120 ft | Components: V, S
• Ranged attack: 1d10 Fire damage.

Guidance.rule:
School: Divination (Concentration) | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: Touch | Components: V, S
• Target adds +1d4 to an ability check.

Light.rule:
School: Evocation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: Touch | Components: V, M
• Touched object sheds bright light in 20ft radius.

Mage Hand.rule:
School: Conjuration | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 30 ft | Components: V, S
• Spectral hand carries up to 10 lbs.

Mending.rule:
School: Transmutation | Casting Time: 1 minute | Range: Touch | Components: V, S, M
• Repair single break or tear in an object.

Message.rule:
School: Transmutation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 120 ft | Components: V, S, M
• Whisper message to a target.

Mind Sliver.rule:
School: Enchantment | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 60 ft | Components: V
• INT save or 1d6 Psychic damage & -1d4 on next save.

Minor Illusion.rule:
School: Illusion | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 30 ft | Components: S, M
• Create sound or static image.

Poison Spray.rule:
School: Necromancy | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 30 ft | Components: V, S
• Ranged spell attack: 1d12 Poison damage.

Prestidigitation.rule:
School: Transmutation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 10 ft | Components: V, S
• Perform minor magic tricks.

Ray of Frost.rule:
School: Evocation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 60 ft | Components: V, S
• Ranged attack: 1d8 Cold damage & -10ft speed.

Resistance.rule:
School: Abjuration (Concentration) | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: Touch | Components: V, S
• Target adds +1d4 to next save.

Sacred Flame.rule:
School: Evocation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 60 ft | Components: V, S
• DEX save or 1d8 Radiant damage.

Shillelagh.rule:
School: Transmutation | Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action | Range: Touch | Components: V, S, M
• Staff/Club uses Spellcasting Mod for attack/damage, 1d8 Force.

Shocking Grasp.rule:
School: Evocation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: Touch | Components: V, S
• Melee attack: 1d8 Lightning damage & target loses Reactions.

Spare the Dying.rule:
School: Necromancy | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 15 ft | Components: V, S
• Stabilize creature at 0 HP.

Starry Wisp.rule:
School: Evocation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 60 ft | Components: V, S
• Ranged attack: 1d8 Radiant damage & emits light.

Thaumaturg.rule:
School: Transmutation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 30 ft | Components: V
• Minor divine wonders.

Thorn Whip.rule:
School: Transmutation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 30 ft | Components: V, S, M
• Melee attack: 1d6 Piercing damage & pull 10ft.

Thunderclap.rule:
School: Evocation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 5 ft radius | Components: S
• CON save or 1d6 Thunder damage.

Toll the Dead.rule:
School: Necromancy | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 60 ft | Components: V, S
• WIS save or 1d8 Necrotic damage (1d12 if missing HP).

True Strike.rule:
School: Divination | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: Self | Components: S, M
• Guided attack using Spellcasting Mod for attack/damage (Radiant).

Vicious Mockery.rule:
School: Enchantment | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 60 ft | Components: V
• WIS save or 1d6 Psychic damage & Disadvantage on next attack.

Alarm.rule:
School: Abjuration (Ritual) | Casting Time: 1 minute | Range: 30 ft | Components: V, S, M
• Set mental or audible alarm in 20ft cube.

Cure Wounds.rule:
School: Abjuration | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: Touch | Components: V, S
• Touch creature: Heal 2d8 + Spellcasting Mod HP.

Detect Magic.rule:
School: Divination (Concentration, Ritual) | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: Self | Components: V, S
• Sense presence and school of magic within 30ft for 10 minutes.

Disguise Self.rule:
School: Illusion | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: Self | Components: V, S
• Change appearance for 1 hour.

Expeditious Retreat.rule:
School: Transmutation (Concentration) | Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action | Range: Self | Components: V, S
• Take Dash action immediately and as Bonus Action on turn.

Faerie Fire.rule:
School: Evocation (Concentration) | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 60 ft | Components: V
• 20ft cube DEX save or outline in light. Attacks vs targets have Advantage; targets can't turn invisible.

False Life.rule:
School: Necromancy | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: Self | Components: V, S, M
• Gain 2d4 + 4 Temporary Hit Points for 1 hour.

Feather Fall.rule:
School: Transmutation | Casting Time: 1 Reaction | Range: 60 ft | Components: V, M
• Up to 5 falling creatures descend slowly and take no fall damage.

Grease.rule:
School: Conjuration | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 60 ft | Components: V, S, M
• 10ft square becomes difficult terrain. Creatures in area DEX save or knock Prone.

Healing Word.rule:
School: Abjuration | Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action | Range: 60 ft | Components: V
• Heal 2d4 + Spellcasting Mod HP.

Identify.rule:
School: Divination (Ritual) | Casting Time: 1 minute | Range: Touch | Components: V, S, M
• Learn magical properties and attuned spells of an item or creature.

Jump.rule:
School: Transmutation | Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action | Range: Touch | Components: V, S, M
• Triple target's jump distance for 1 minute.

Longstrider.rule:
School: Transmutation | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: Touch | Components: V, S, M
• Increase target's speed by 10ft for 1 hour.

Purify Food and Drink.rule:
School: Transmutation (Ritual) | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 10 ft | Components: V, S
• Purify nonmagical food and drink within 5ft sphere.

Sanctuary.rule:
School: Abjuration | Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action | Range: 30 ft | Components: V, S, M
• Wards creature. Attackers against target must make WIS save or choose new target.

Shield.rule:
School: Abjuration | Casting Time: 1 Reaction | Range: Self | Components: V, S
• +5 AC until next turn & immune to Magic Missile.

Tasha's Hideous Laughter.rule:
School: Enchantment (Concentration) | Casting Time: 1 Action | Range: 30 ft | Components: V, S, M
• Target WIS save or falls Prone and Incapacitated with laughter.
